user.title: HyperPasscode
user.description:
Codes live in Home Assistant rather than inside a lock, so one policy engine can govern any credential and authorise any action.

There is nothing to configure here. Add your first scope once setup finishes.

error.code_collision: That code is already in use. Two identical codes would make the audit log unattributable.
error.weak_code: That code was rejected as weak. Turn off 'Reject weak codes' in the integration settings to allow it.

user.title: Add code
user.description: Leave the code blank to have one generated. You will be shown it on the next step.

data_description.name: What this code is for, such as Cleaner or Grocery delivery.
data_description.scope_ids: The scopes this code opens. A code with no scope cannot be used anywhere yet.
data_description.keep_viewable: Stores the code in clear text so it can be read back and shared again. Without this it can only be regenerated.
data_description.owner: The person this code belongs to. Their name then appears in the audit log and in automations.
data_description.tags: Labels for filtering, and for revoking a whole group of codes at once.
data_description.valid_from: Leave empty to make it usable straight away.
data_description.max_uses: Lifetime limit. Set to 1 for a one-time code.
data_description.schedule_entities: Schedule helpers that must all be on. These recur weekly, so pair them with the dates above for a date range.
data_description.condition_entities: Any on/off entities that must all be on. Point one at a calendar to make the code live only during matching events.

created.title: Code created
created.description:
The code for {label} is:

**{code}**

Write it down now. Unless you ticked 'Keep code viewable' this is the only time it will be shown. Press Submit to save it.

reconfigure.title: Edit code
reconfigure.description: Leave the code blank to keep the existing one. Use counts and history are unaffected by changes here.

data_description.code: Leave empty to keep the current code.
data_description.keep_viewable: Turning this off discards the stored copy of the code, so it can no longer be read back.
data_description.max_uses: Counted against the uses already recorded, so lowering it below the current count retires the code.
data_description.schedule_entities: Schedule helpers that must all be on.
data_description.condition_entities: Any on/off entities that must all be on.

user.title: Add scope
user.description: A scope is something codes are entered against, such as a front door, a gate or an alarm. It becomes a device with its own entities.

data_description.default_actions: Run whenever a valid code is entered here, so the common case needs no automation at all.
data_description.code_length: Submit automatically once this many keys have been pressed. Leave empty to wait for a terminator key.
data_description.terminator_keys: Keys that submit what has been typed so far, usually # or *.
data_description.inter_key_timeout: Clear a half-typed code after this many seconds without a keystroke.
data_description.lockout_threshold: Leave empty to use the integration-wide setting. Set to 0 to disable lockout for this scope.
data_description.lockout_duration: How long this scope refuses codes once it locks out. Leave empty to use the integration-wide setting.

reconfigure.title: Edit scope
reconfigure.description: Changes take effect immediately. Lockout counters and any half-typed code are left alone.

data_description.default_actions: Run whenever a valid code is entered here.
data_description.code_length: Submit automatically at this length. Leave empty to wait for a terminator key.
data_description.terminator_keys: Keys that submit what has been typed so far.
data_description.inter_key_timeout: Clear a half-typed code after this many seconds without a keystroke.
data_description.lockout_threshold: Leave empty to use the integration-wide setting. Set to 0 to disable lockout for this scope.
data_description.lockout_duration: How long this scope refuses codes once it locks out. Leave empty to use the integration-wide setting.

data.log_failed_plaintext: Log what was typed on failure

data_description.reject_weak_codes: Refuses repeated digits, sequential runs and well-known codes, for typed codes as well as generated ones.
data_description.weak_code_blocklist: Extra values to treat as weak, such as a house number or a birth year.
data_description.per_credential_entities: Gives every credential its own use counter and enable switch. Turn this off if you have many credentials, or the entity list becomes unusable.
data_description.lockout_threshold: Set to 0 to disable lockout entirely.
data_description.audit_log_size: How many submissions to keep. Every submission also fires an event, so history is kept by the recorder regardless.
data_description.log_failed_plaintext: Off by default: a failed attempt is usually a typo of a real code, so recording it would leak that code into your logs.

trigger_type.rate_limited: Code refused for exceeding its rate limit
trigger_type.lockout: Locked out after too many failures

submit.name: Submit code
submit.description: Validates a code against a scope and runs its actions if accepted.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where the code came from. Credentials can be restricted to particular sources.

submit_key.name: Submit keystroke
submit_key.description: Feeds one keystroke into a scope's buffer. Submits on a terminator key or at the scope's fixed code length, and clears itself after the inter-key timeout.

key.name: Key
key.description: The single key that was pressed.

scope_id.name: Scope
scope_id.description: The scope whose buffer to clear.

test_code.name: Test code
test_code.description: Reports whether a code would be accepted, and why not if it would be refused. Records nothing and runs no actions.

create_code.name: Create code
create_code.description: Creates a credential, generating a code when you do not supply one. The code is returned once.

label.name: Label
label.description: A name for this credential, such as Cleaner.

scope_ids.name: Scopes
scope_ids.description: The scopes this code works on.

code_type.name: Code type
code_type.description: Digits only, or letters and digits.

keep_viewable.name: Keep code viewable
keep_viewable.description: Stores the code in clear so it can be read back later. Needed to re-share a code; otherwise the code can only be regenerated.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: The person this credential belongs to.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Labels for filtering and bulk revocation.

valid_until.name: Valid until
valid_until.description: Not usable from this moment on.

schedule_entities.name: Schedules
schedule_entities.description: Schedule helpers that must all be on. These recur weekly, so pair them with valid from and valid until for a date range.

condition_entities.name: Conditions
condition_entities.description: Any on/off entities that must all be on. Point one at a calendar to make a code valid only during matching events.

max_uses.name: Maximum uses
max_uses.description: Lifetime limit. Set to 1 for a one-time code.

allowed_sources.name: Allowed sources
allowed_sources.description: Restricts where this code may be entered. Empty means anywhere.

create_otp.name: Create one-time code
create_otp.description: Creates a single-use, time-limited code and returns it. The quickest way to let a delivery driver in.

scope_id.name: Scope
scope_id.description: The scope the code works on.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: Defaults to now. Set a future time for tomorrow's delivery.

valid_until.name: Valid until
valid_until.description: Overrides duration when both are given.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the code stays valid. Defaults to two hours.

keep_viewable.name: Keep code viewable
keep_viewable.description: On by default, since a delivery code you cannot read back is of no use.

revoke.name: Revoke code
revoke.description: Permanently disables a credential. Unlike disabling, this cannot be undone.

delete_code.name: Delete code
delete_code.description: Removes a credential and its entities outright.

set_enabled.name: Enable or disable code
set_enabled.description: Temporarily turns a credential on or off.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the credential may be used.

revoke_all.name: Revoke all codes
revoke_all.description: The panic wipe. Revokes every credential matching the filters, or all of them when no filter is given.

scope_id.name: Scope
scope_id.description: Only revoke credentials granted on this scope.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: Only revoke credentials carrying one of these tags, such as guest.

export_audit.name: Export audit log
export_audit.description: Returns the submission log, newest first.

format.name: Format
format.description: JSON entries or a CSV document.

create_scope.name: Create scope
create_scope.description: Adds a target that codes are entered against, such as a door, a gate or an alarm. Becomes a device carrying its own entities.

default_actions.name: Default actions
default_actions.description: Run whenever a valid code is entered, so the common case needs no automation at all.

code_length.name: Code length
code_length.description: Submit automatically once this many keys have been pressed. Leave empty to wait for a terminator key.

terminator_keys.name: Terminator keys
terminator_keys.description: Keys that submit the buffer, typically # or *.

inter_key_timeout.name: Inter-key timeout
inter_key_timeout.description: Clear a half-typed code after this long without a keystroke.

lockout_threshold.name: Failed attempts before lockout
lockout_threshold.description: Overrides the integration setting for this scope.

lockout_duration.name: Lockout duration
lockout_duration.description: Overrides the integration setting for this scope.

default_actions.name: Default actions
default_actions.description: Run whenever a valid code is entered.

inter_key_timeout.name: Inter-key timeout
inter_key_timeout.description: Clear a half-typed code after this long.

delete_scope.name: Delete scope
delete_scope.description: Removes a scope, its device and every grant pointing at it.
